description: This file defines an abstract class UnsafeWriter used for writing various data types into an unsafe memory buffer, including methods for handling nulls, primitive types, complex data structures, and byte arrays, within the Spark SQL Catalyst code generation module.

classes.name: UnsafeWriter
classes.description: An abstract class providing methods for writing various data types and structures into an unsafe memory buffer, used in Spark SQL code generation.

methods.name: setNull1Bytes
methods.description: Abstract method to set a null value with 1 byte size.

methods.name: setNull2Bytes
methods.description: Abstract method to set a null value with 2 bytes size.

methods.name: setNull4Bytes
methods.description: Abstract method to set a null value with 4 bytes size.

methods.name: setNull8Bytes
methods.description: Abstract method to set a null value with 8 bytes size.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Overloaded methods to write primitive data types and complex structures into the buffer at a specified ordinal position.

methods.name: writeUnalignedBytes
methods.description: Writes a byte array into the buffer, handling padding and updating offset and size.

methods.name: writeAlignedBytes
methods.description: Writes a byte array into the buffer with alignment considerations.
